writing.overall_comment: A concise and technically accurate SwiftUI skill reference, but it would be more valuable with concrete SwiftData/animation examples, edge cases, and step-by-step implementation guidance.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately match the SwiftUI UI, state, navigation, and SwiftData focus, though the advertised animations/transitions coverage is only mentioned and not demonstrated.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The Observation and NavigationStack examples are syntactically correct and useful, but there are no failure-path, loading/error, animation, or SwiftData examples despite those being claimed or listed.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The guidance and snippets are practical, but the document reads as a reference rather than an explicit workflow with unambiguous steps for implementing SwiftUI features.

suggestions: Add concrete failure-path, loading/error, animation, and SwiftData code examples in the sections that claim or list them, matching the existing Observation and NavigationStack example style.
Rewrite the implementation guidance as an explicit step-by-step workflow for each SwiftUI feature, covering setup, state/data flow, view composition, and validation instead of a reference-style list.
